    # We only care about states 1 to N-1. Index 0 is unused.
    status = [0] * (N + 1)

    # Iterate backwards from N-1 down to 1

        # Possible next states

        if n + 1 <= N:
            moves.append(n + 1)
        if 2 * n <= N:
            moves.append(2 * n)

            status[n] = 2  # Winning (W)
            continue

        # If no moves are possible (should only happen if N is very small and n > N/2,

             # This path should not be reached for N > 1 and n >= 1,
